title: Sony BRAVIA 4K UR2 (device BRAVIA_UR2_4K, MediaTek)
header:
Sony BRAVIA 4K UR2 (device BRAVIA_UR2_4K, MediaTek)
Android 10 (Android TV, API 29), firmware BRAVIA_UR2_4K_UC-user 10 QTG3.200305.006.S97 662301

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-ur2/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-ur2/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (the restore.sh default is correct).
Live TV / tuner app: com.sony.dtv.tvx (set it as live_tv_package in the launcher's config.xml).
Keep the com.sony.dtv.tvinput.* services, com.sony.dtv.braviasync*, com.sony.dtv.tvapi,
com.sony.dtv.sonysystemservice and the Sony settings apps: they drive HDMI, the tuner, Bravia Sync
and the remote.
Already disabled at the factory: com.sony.dtv.b2b.vendorprotocol, com.sony.dtv.b2b.softap,
screnmirroring.com.

Applied one afternoon with the dock set to Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, ZEE5. Not yet lived with
for weeks; if something breaks, re-enable it with `pm enable <package>` and please report it.
